title: Screening transition metal electrodes for achieving near 100% selectivity to urea via electroreduction of NO3− and CO2 at 100 mA cm−2 current density
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,115-128
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00841C, Paper
Nishithan C. Kani, Ishita Goyal, Samuel A. Olusegun, Sreenivasulu Chinnabattigalla, Rajan R. Bhawnani, Ksenija D. Glusac, Joseph A. Gauthier, Meenesh R. Singh
Electrochemical synthesis offers a sustainable approach to convert waste NO3− and CO2 into urea under ambient conditions. Here, we report Ag as a highly active catalyst achieving ∼100% selectivity and −100 mA cm−2 urea current density.
